title: Wisdom
definition: Wisdom is skillful living under the fear of the Lord, shaped by God's Word and applied to real life.
summary: Wisdom applies God's truth to decisions, relationships, speech, priorities, and conduct.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the wisdom of God, and in Him believers learn the way of life that pleases the Father.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Wisdom is more than intelligence or experience. It begins with the fear of the Lord and grows through receiving God's Word, trusting His character, and walking in obedience.

Wisdom helps believers discern what is true, good, fitting, and faithful. It shapes decisions, relationships, speech, money, work, ministry, and responses to suffering.

Christ is the wisdom of God. The wise life is not merely practical success; it is life ordered under Christ's lordship and aligned with God's truth.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: People can be knowledgeable and still foolish if they reject God. Wisdom matters because life requires more than information; believers need discernment that is rooted in reverence for the Lord.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Ask God for wisdom and search Scripture for His counsel. Before acting, consider what honors Christ, loves others, resists sin, and reflects the fear of the Lord.
